{{Field procedure|summary=Use the contacts and refinery workflow to stop collector limpets from repeatedly bringing in fragments you do not want to keep.}}

Use this procedure during a mining run when collectors keep retrieving fragments that are not part of the current cargo plan.

{{Draft warning}}

== Before you start ==

* Know which commodity or material the run is trying to keep.
* Have active fragments, chunks, or canisters visible in the contacts list.
* Check the [[Refinery]] before discarding anything valuable.

== Procedure ==

{{Procedure steps|
# Open the contacts list while fragments or chunks are nearby.
# Identify a fragment type that is not wanted for the current run.
# Add that fragment or commodity to the ignore list using the available contact/refinery controls.
# Check the refinery for existing partial bins of the same unwanted resource.
# Vent or clear unwanted refinery bins if they are blocking useful fragments.
# Relaunch or continue collectors only after the ignore choice is set.
# Recheck the contacts list after the next asteroid, because a different unwanted commodity may need its own ignore action.
}}

== Completion check ==

The procedure is complete when collector limpets stop prioritizing the unwanted fragment type and useful refinery bins can continue filling.

== Common problems ==

* '''Collectors still bring the wrong resource:''' verify the correct contact type was ignored and repeat the process for other unwanted commodities.
* '''The refinery remains full:''' ignoring future fragments does not clear existing bins; vent or clear blocked bins separately.
* '''A useful commodity was ignored by mistake:''' remove it from the ignore list before continuing the run.
* '''The run target changes:''' review the ignore list before switching commodities or moving to a new hotspot.
